subject.title: fix(doctor): skip groupAllowFrom migration for schemaless external channels

question: Should OpenClaw core doctor land the fail-closed generated-schema guard for schemaless external channel `groupAllowFrom` writes?
rationale: The bug is real and the patch is narrow, but the merge changes a released doctor migration default for external plugins whose schemas core cannot inspect.

options.title: Land Schema-Verified Guard
options.body: Merge the focused fix after normal gates, accepting that unknown external channel configs are left untouched by core doctor.

options.title: Add External Opt-In First
options.body: Pause this PR and design a plugin doctor/schema capability for external channels that intentionally want this migration.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Protection
options.body: Close or replace this PR only if broader config-protection work proves the same email/RCS regression and covers this exact write path.

recommendation.title: Land Schema-Verified Guard
recommendation.body: Merge the focused fix after normal gates, accepting that unknown external channel configs are left untouched by core doctor.

likelyOwner.reason: This account merged the fallback migration being repaired and is the strongest history signal for the compatibility-boundary choice.
